Context: Educationally Backward Classes (OBCs)

3.  
Revision of Income criteria for Creamy Layer.It has been decided to raise the income limit from t 6 lakhs to t 8 lakhs p.a. for determining Creamy Layer amongst the other backward classes. This limit takes effect from 1-9-2017. ' ' - Orders 12 and 12-A, Section 3.
